subject: Onsite workshop logistics — access windows & escort plan
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@pioneer-analytics.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onsite workshop logistics — access windows & escort plan

Evan —

Thanks again for confirming the May 27-28 executive workshop at Downtown Conference Center. A few operational asks so we can finalize the room schedule and agenda routing: 

1) Arrival windows: we need a 60-minute window for executive arrivals each morning (27th/28th). Can you confirm preferred arrival window for the execs and any VIP badge names?

2) Security & badge process: the venue requires names 48 hours in advance. I attached a visitor spreadsheet — please fill Column B with a preferred escort point (lobby / loading dock).

3) AV & staging drop: if Pioneer is bringing an external laptop or encoder, let us know model + any HDMI/Thunderbolt adapters so AV can pre-stage cables.

4) Escort policy: Downtown requires a Redwood staff escort any time attendees are unaccompanied in back-of-house areas. Grace, can you confirm who will be on escort rotation?

Quick next steps: Evan — if you can populate the attached visitor list and confirm arrival windows by EOD Friday (5/16), we’ll issue final venue passes and send the access instructions to your team.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Pioneer_MA_visitor_list.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Camila —

Thanks — filled the visitor list and noted two VIPs arriving earlier: 
- Maria Lopez (CEO) — prefers 8:15 AM arrival on 27th
- Daniel Chen (Head of Product) — prefers 9:00 AM arrival on 27th

For general attendees we’ll box them into 9:30–10:30 AM on both days. We will bring two MacBook Pros (M1) as main laptops and one external NDI encoder for streaming — Grace, happy to coordinate adapters. 

One question on escorts: will Redwood provide a dedicated escort for morning arrivals, or will the on-site Solutions Engineer alternate? If we can have one dedicated escort from 8:00–10:30 on the 27th that would help maintain VIP prep time.

I also looped in venue security (security@downtown-venue.com) for badge processing.

—Evan

Evan / Camila —

I can take the dedicated escort for the morning VIP window on the 27th (8:00–10:30). I’ll also be the point for AV staging checks at 7:30 AM. A few operational notes: 

- Please populate the attached visitor list with company and mobile number for each guest — venue security enforces phone verification at check-in.
- For the NDI encoder, bring an HDMI breakout and one USB-C power brick. If you prefer, we can stage a spare HDMI cable.
- Loading dock arrival: if you plan to use the loading dock, Security — can you confirm a 7:00–7:45 reserved slot for Pioneer’s truck?

I’ll draft a short arrival timeline and the escort roster and share the final run-of-show once I have the completed visitor list.

Grace Oconnor

Confirmed: loading dock slot reserved 7:00–7:45 AM on 27 May for Pioneer Analytics (truck plate # BQZ-114). Venue will accept visitor name list up to 24 hours prior; however, we can accept preliminary badge-only lists 48 hours prior for expedited pickup.
